title: Kamadhenu training example
description: One text↔audio pair for Sanskrit TTS / chanting. Fields may be null when unknown; the validator reports what is missing, nothing is deleted. Laghu/guru, metre and pāda fields come from the DGE Chandas engine (js/chandas.js) unless `chandas_source` says otherwise.

id.description: stable id = 'km_' + first 12 hex of the audio file's SHA-1

text.description: Devanagari text exactly as spoken in the audio (pādas separated by newlines; no verse numbers, no speaker lines)

normalized_text.description: SLP1 transliteration of `text` used for the frontend; produced by tools/kamadhenu/texts.py

audio.description: path relative to the repository root (or a URL for the DGE audio repo)

speaker.description: reciter name, or 'unattributed:<folder>' until the voice decision is made

source.description: where the file came from: dge_linked | drive | recording_takes | generated

meter.description: Devanagari vṛtta/jāti name from the DGE engine, e.g. वसन्ततिलका, अनुष्टुप्; 'गद्यम्' for prose; null when unknown

pada_text.description: the pādas as separate strings, in order

laghu_guru.description: L/G per akṣara, pādas separated by |

gana.description: gaṇa letters per pāda, pādas separated by |

yati.description: caesura positions in akṣaras, from the metre database

recording_quality.description: A clean · B usable · C marginal · D clipped/noisy/very low bitrate

text_audio_confidence.description: how sure the mapping is that this audio speaks this text
